meta.stylePrefix: Professional B2B industrial photography style. Tight composition filling the entire frame edge to edge, no empty sky or ceiling, no wasted space at top or bottom, subject occupies the full square canvas. Bottom-weighted composition, main subject occupies lower two-thirds of frame.
meta.note: Sub-hero image regeneration — each prompt uses unique composition angle and concrete scene.

images.prompt: Bird's eye flat lay of six UAV component types arranged on a dark engineering workbench: a flight controller PCB with visible IMU chip, an ESC power module with thick gauge wires, a brushless motor with propeller mounted, a carbon fiber airframe arm section, a telemetry antenna module, and a gimbal camera assembly. Each component clearly separated and labeled by function zone. Top-down view, even lighting, components fill the frame edge to edge.

Extreme macro close-up of a drone flight controller PCB at 45-degree angle. Gold-plated IMU sensor chip in razor-sharp focus at center, surrounding SMD capacitors and MCU processor slightly defocused for depth. Green solder mask with visible copper trace routing. Dramatic side lighting from upper left casting subtle shadows across components. Pin headers along bottom edge. Tight crop, PCB fills entire frame.

Low angle shot looking up at a row of electronic speed controllers mounted on a test bench. Thick silicone power wires in red and black running from MOSFET banks to bullet connectors. Large electrolytic capacitors visible. Blue power indicator LEDs glowing. Background shows oscilloscope screen with waveform traces. Shot from below at 30-degree upward angle. Tight composition, subject fills lower two-thirds.

Dynamic 15-degree dutch tilt shot of a large brushless UAV motor with carbon fiber propeller mounted. Motor stator windings visible through side openings, copper coils catching warm light. The propeller blades sweep diagonally across the frame creating motion energy. Shallow depth of field on motor body, propeller tips slightly motion-blurred. Dark technical background with subtle blue accent light. Subject fills frame.

Eye-level immersive shot inside a carbon fiber UAV airframe assembly area. A partially assembled quadcopter frame on a workbench, visible carbon weave pattern under workshop lighting. Aluminum CNC-machined motor mounts attached to arms. Foldable frame mechanism visible in half-open position. Tools and calipers in background. Shot as if standing at the workbench looking at the frame. Bottom-weighted, frame occupies lower two-thirds.

Shot through a foreground spectrum analyzer screen showing RF frequency bands, framing a telemetry radio module and GPS antenna on a test bench behind it. The spectrum analyzer creates a green waveform frame around the subject. RF shield cans removed from the telemetry module showing internal circuitry. Coaxial cables with SMA connectors in sharp focus. Depth layering: screen in foreground, hardware in mid-ground, dark lab background.

Split diptych composition: left side shows a gimbal-stabilized camera payload in exploded view with lens, IMU board, and damping mounts separated; right side shows the same payload fully assembled and mounted under a drone. Clean white technical background on left, dark hangar environment on right. The split runs vertically through center. Tight composition, no empty space.

Bird's eye collage showing five UAV application scenes arranged around a central drone: industrial inspection drone inspecting a pipeline (top-left), mapping drone over terrain with LIDAR sensor (top-right), delivery drone with package compartment (bottom-left), agricultural spray drone over crops (bottom-right), research drone with sensor array at center. Each scene shot from above. Seamless dark background blending all scenes. Tight composition edge to edge.

Low angle shot from beneath a drone inspecting an industrial pipe rack. The drone hovers above, its downward-facing camera and thermal sensor pointing at the viewer. Pipe structure with flanges and valves visible in background. Steam vapor adding atmosphere. The drone's rotors and landing gear visible from below against industrial sky. Dramatic upward perspective, subject fills upper two-thirds with pipe structure in lower third.

High angle drone POV shot looking down at a LIDAR-equipped mapping UAV flying over varied terrain. The UAV's shadow visible on the ground below with contour lines overlaying the landscape like a topographic map. The drone body and sensor pod visible at top of frame. Ground below shows fields, roads, and elevation data visualization. Split perspective: drone hardware above, mapped terrain below.

Eye-level immersive shot inside a drone delivery hub at golden hour. A cargo drone with open package bay sits on a landing pad marked with helipad graphics. A technician in dark uniform loads a parcel into the bay. Warehouse racking with drone spare parts and battery charging stations along the walls. Warm sunset light streaming through high windows casting long shadows. Bottom-weighted, action fills lower two-thirds.

Bird's eye top-down view of an agricultural spray drone hovering low over bright green crop rows. The drone centered in frame with its spray boom arms extending out, fine mist visible beneath. Geometric crop rows radiating outward creating a natural framing pattern. Early morning golden light, long shadows from the drone. The entire square frame filled with the crop pattern, drone as focal centerpiece.

Macro close-up of a research UAV's modular sensor bay with multiple scientific instruments exposed. A hyperspectral camera lens in center focus, air quality sampling intake on one side, radiation sensor module on the other. Quick-release mounting mechanism visible. Laboratory setting with data acquisition laptop screen showing real-time telemetry graphs in background, defocused. Tight crop filling entire frame.

Eye-level immersive wide shot of a UAV engineering office space. Engineers at workstations with dual monitors showing 3D CAD models of drone frames and PCB layouts. A completed drone prototype on a central display table. Whiteboard covered in system architecture diagrams and interface specifications. Modern industrial interior with exposed ceiling, warm LED lighting. Shot from doorway perspective, the room fills the frame edge to edge.

Low angle wide shot across a drone component production floor. Rows of pick-and-place SMT machines assembling PCBs in foreground, reflow ovens with orange internal glow in mid-ground, workers at QC inspection stations in background. Fluorescent industrial lighting. The low angle emphasizes the scale of the production line. Bottom-weighted composition, machines and workers fill lower two-thirds.

Macro close-up of quality inspection: a technician's gloved hands holding a flight controller PCB under a magnifying lamp. The magnifying lens creates a circular frame showing solder joint details at 10x magnification. Surrounding area shows the inspection workstation with test probes, multimeter, and QC checklist on a tablet. The magnified area occupies the central 40% of frame. Tight composition.

Dynamic 15-degree dutch tilt of finished UAV component kits being packed for export. Open shipping crate with custom-cut foam inserts holding flight controllers, ESCs, and motors in individual compartments. Packing slip and quality certificates visible. Warehouse racking with labeled boxes behind. A hand places the final foam layer into the crate. The slight tilt adds energy to the logistics scene. Bottom-weighted.

Split diptych composition: left side shows an initial concept sketch and component BOM on a desk with coffee cup, representing project start; right side shows the completed and tested UAV on a flight-ready bench with check marks on a tablet. Warm desk lamp lighting on left, bright clean bench lighting on right. The contrast between concept and completion. Tight composition edge to edge.

Bird's eye flat lay of three completed UAV projects on a dark technical surface: a heavy-lift agricultural hexacopter with spray system, a compact inspection quadcopter with thermal camera, and a fixed-wing mapping drone with LIDAR pod. Each drone photographed from above with its key specifications noted on small tech-label cards beside it. Clean studio lighting, systematic arrangement. Fills the entire square frame.

Overhead bird's eye view of a designer's desk with an open engineering notebook showing hand-drawn UAV system block diagrams. A tablet displaying a 3D PCB layout beside it. Mechanical pencil, digital calipers, and a reference component (flight controller) arranged around the notebook. Warm desk lamp creating a focused pool of light on the design work. The notebook and tablet fill the frame.

Eye-level shot of an applications engineer at a desk, facing a large display showing a UAV component compatibility matrix. The engineer's hand gestures toward a specific cell in the matrix. On the desk: component samples (FC, ESC, motor) arranged by interface type, a phone headset, and a marked-up specification sheet. Warm, approachable lighting. Bottom-weighted composition, the interaction fills lower two-thirds.

Shot through a partially disassembled drone frame in foreground, looking through the carbon fiber arms to a desk with open technical articles and component diagrams behind. The drone frame creates a natural geometric frame-within-a-frame. Articles visible on a tablet screen showing UAV engineering content. Warm tungsten desk lamp lighting. Depth layering: frame in foreground, work area in mid-ground.

Eye-level shot of an engineering consultation in progress. Two people at a desk — one pointing at a UAV component specification sheet, the other taking notes on a tablet. The desk surface shows: a flight controller sample, a motor with propeller, and a marked-up BOM spreadsheet. Clean modern office with component storage shelves in soft-focus background. Natural window light mixed with warm interior lighting. Bottom-weighted, interaction fills lower two-thirds.

Split composition showing modular UAV configuration: left side shows individual component options laid out in a selection matrix (3 FC options, 3 ESC options, 3 motor options), right side shows them assembled into a complete matched powertrain stack on a test bench. The left-to-right flow from selection to integration. Clean white surface on left, dark technical bench on right. Tight composition filling entire frame.

Macro close-up of a UAV powertrain on a test bench with instrumentation probes attached. An oscilloscope screen in background shows PWM waveforms. A thrust measurement gauge with digital readout in mid-ground. The motor and propeller in foreground with a laser tachometer aimed at the prop hub. Red and black test leads connecting to the ESC power input. Dramatic blue under-lighting from the bench surface. Tight crop filling frame.

Eye-level shot of a clean engineering workspace with a tablet showing a component configuration interface, a printed BOM with handwritten notes beside it, and reference component samples (FC, ESC, motor) placed on a dark gray desk mat. A digital calipers and a cup of coffee complete the scene. Natural daylight from a window creates soft shadows. The tablet and BOM are the focal points. Bottom-weighted composition.

Abstract composition: a server rack viewed through a frosted glass partition with subtle green LED indicators glowing through the glass. The frosted glass creates a privacy-filter effect. Ethernet cables with organized cable management visible at the edges. Dark environment with minimalist aesthetic. The glass texture and LED glow create an atmospheric security-themed image without literal symbols. Tight frame, no empty space.

Abstract composition: a close-up of a precision-machined metal surface with laser-etched specification numbers and tolerance markings. The etched text catches side lighting creating a legible but subtle pattern. A digital calipers measuring a component in the defocused background. Dark industrial aesthetic with metallic textures. The etching represents precision and formal documentation. Tight frame edge to edge.
